name: pill-mods
description: Claude Code mods：繁中「下一步」膠囊、每個區塊右上角複製、貼圖縮圖預覽、對話內 mermaid 出圖

plugins.name: pill-steps
plugins.description: next-steps (hamzafer) restyled: next prompts as Claude-colored pills above the prompt. Press 1-3 in an empty prompt, 0 to dismiss.

plugins.name: pill-copy
plugins.description: copy-band (yash-gadodia) restyled: each code block in the last answer as a Claude-colored copy pill above the prompt.

plugins.name: image-peek
plugins.description: image-view (jarrodwatts) fixed for newer Claude Code: thumbnails of pasted images above the prompt, read from $TMPDIR/clipboard-*.png.

plugins.name: mermaid-pane
plugins.description: Draws ```mermaid blocks in Claude's replies as pictures right in the conversation (dark theme, local render via mermaid-cli).
